summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The U.S. Micro Cap Portfolio ETF (DFMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in micro cap equity. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively selecting US micro-cap companies, with a tilt towards smaller firms that have lower relative prices and higher profitability. DFMC was launched on Mar 19, 2026 and is issued by Dimensional.
